reproduction_target: The epigenome-wide association analyses of Illumina EPIC BeadChip DNA methylation from the EMC antidepressant trial (NCT00974155): CPACOR-based preprocessing/QC (642,148 CpGs retained), covariate construction (control-probe PCs, Houseman cell-type deconvolution, AHRR smoking proxy, genotype PCs), three association models (linear model for day-56 outcome; two lme4 linear mixed models), bacon inflation correction, comb-p/ENmix DMR calling, missMethyl gometh GO enrichment, and the overlap check against Engelmann et al. 2022 DMRs. Wet-lab steps (DNA extraction, bisulfite conversion, array hybridisation/scanning, clinical rating) are W/OOS.
granularity_note: Stage-1 prose triage. No workflow file, no code repository and no script deposit exists for this paper, so steps were derived from named tool/analysis invocations in 'Methods and Materials'. Supplementary Information S1 (preprocessing/QC thresholds), S2 (genotype QC) and S3 (bacon correction details) are referenced by the Methods but were NOT retrieved at Stage 1; steps that depend on them carry the 'needs-supplement' subflag. Consecutive sentences describing one tool invocation were collapsed into one step; the three association models are kept as three separate steps because they use different software (lm vs lme4) and different CpG denominators.

steps.label: Genomic DNA extraction from whole blood (QIAamp DNA Blood Midi Kit, Qiagen)
Bisulfite conversion of 500 ng genomic DNA (EZ-96 DNA Methylation-Gold Kit, Zymo Research)
Genome-wide methylation profiling on Infinium HumanMethylationEPIC BeadChip, scanned on Illumina HiScan (Helmholtz Institute Muenchen)
Clinical phenotyping: M.I.N.I. / SCID-II diagnosis verification and weekly HAMD-17 rating by blinded raters (baseline to day 56)
Extraction of methylation values from raw signal intensity (IDAT) files using 'an updated version of the CPACOR pipeline' (Lehne et al. 2015, 2016)
Sample- and probe-level QC / filtering (642,148 CpG sites retained; 164 patients + 51 controls retained); thresholds deferred to Supplementary Information S1
Principal component analysis on EPIC internal control probes; first four PCs retained as batch covariates
Reference-based cell-type deconvolution (Houseman et al. 2012 method, six proportions) plus variance-inflation-factor screening and exclusion of the granulocyte proportion
Covariate construction: smoking proxy from methylation at AHRR cg05575921, group- and sex-specific mean imputation of two missing BMI values

Genotype quality control and derivation of two genotype-based principal components for population stratification (n = 2 patients, n = 3 controls dropped); details deferred to Supplementary Information S2
Variance partitioning of covariate contributions using linear mixed models (variancePartition R package; Hoffman & Schadt 2016)
Model 1 - cross-sectional linear regression EWAS predicting day-56 HAMD from baseline methylation + baseline HAMD across 642,148 CpG sites
Model 2 - longitudinal linear mixed model in patients (n = 162, four time points, random intercepts, time + continuous HAMD effects) using lme4; 606,546 CpG sites after singularity checks
Estimated marginal means of methylation per time point using the emmeans R package (Lenth et al. 2023)
Model 3 - linear mixed model comparing patients (n = 162) and controls (n = 48) baseline to day 28 (time, HAMD, group effects); 562,713 CpG sites after singularity checks
Multiple-testing correction by Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (q-values) across all models

QQ plots / genomic inflation factor lambda estimation and Bayesian bias-and-inflation correction with the bacon R package (van Iterson et al. 2017), applied to Model 3 (lambda = 1.55); details deferred to Supplementary Information S3
CpG annotation against the manufacturer manifest 'Illumina MethylationEPIC v1 B5'
DMR calling with the comb-p function of the ENmix R package (Xu et al. 2016): max inter-CpG distance 750 bp, bin size 500 bp, seed p < 0.001, Sidak correction, minimum 2 CpGs per region

GO biological-process gene-set enrichment with the gometh function of the missMethyl R package (Phipson et al. 2016): input CpGs at nominal p < 0.001, background = full tested CpG set, EPIC array annotation
Overlap assessment of present nominally significant DMPs/DMRs against the genomic coordinates of DMRs reported in Engelmann et al. 2022

headline.static_readiness: 0/17 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 0/17 (0%) readiness upper bound - (n_R + n_RI)/|S| = (0 + 0)/17. Every computational step is capped at NI by a single paper-level blocker: the preprint carries NO data availability statement, NO code availability statement, NO repository (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Zenodo/Software Heritage) and NO data accession (GEO/SRA/ENA/ArrayExpress/dbGaP/EGA/figshare) anywhere in the body, back matter or acknowledgements. Data axis = 0 on all 17 steps, so no step can reach RI regardless of how well its parameters are described. NI rather than X because the gap is remediable by the authors (the EMC cohort exists and is registered as NCT00974155; controlled-access deposit plus a script deposit would close it), not because any documented access path exists today. Note the asymmetry: parameter documentation is unusually good for several steps (comb-p window/bin/seed/Sidak, gometh thresholds and background, cg05575921 smoking proxy, EPIC v1 B5 manifest), so this paper is blocked by artifact deposition, not by methods writing.
headline.coverage: 17 computational steps assessed from the bioRxiv v1 JATS full-text Methods prose (Methods and Materials: study cohort, study procedures, quantification of DNA methylation, data preprocessing/QC/filtering, covariates, EWAS, downstream analyses, overlap assessment). 4 wet-lab / non-computational steps (DNA extraction, bisulfite conversion, EPIC array hybridisation + HiScan scanning, clinical HAMD-17/M.I.N.I./SCID-II phenotyping) counted in W and excluded from |S|. Computational coverage |S|/(|S|+|W|) = 17/21 (81%). Supplementary Information S1-S3 not retrieved at Stage 1.

gaps.where: whole paper - no Data Availability section exists
gaps.missing: No repository accession of any kind for the EPIC methylation data (no GEO/ArrayExpress/EGA/dbGaP/SRA/figshare/Zenodo identifier), no sample-to-IDAT mapping, and no documented data access committee or request procedure. The only identifier given for the underlying material is the clinical trial registration 'ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT00974155', which is a trial registration and not a data accession.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the raw IDATs plus the sample sheet under controlled access (EGA or dbGaP) consistent with the Landesaerztekammer Rheinland-Pfalz ethics approval, and add a Data Availability statement naming the accession and the DAC request path. If deposit is impossible, state the legal basis and the contact route explicitly.

gaps.where: whole paper - no Code Availability section exists
gaps.missing: No analysis code is deposited or linked. The three association models, the covariate construction, the DMR pipeline invocation and the enrichment analysis exist only as prose descriptions; no script, notebook, or repository URL appears anywhere in the article, the back matter, or the acknowledgements.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the R analysis scripts (preprocessing wrapper, model fitting, comb-p/gometh calls, plotting) in a public repository with a Zenodo DOI and cite it in a Code Availability statement.

gaps.where: Methods > Data preprocessing, QC, and filtering (step C1)
gaps.missing: The preprocessing uses 'an updated version of the CPACOR pipeline (Lehne et al., 2015, 2016)'. The modification is neither described in the main text nor deposited, so the exact transformation from IDAT to the 642,148-site matrix is not obtainable. The base CPACOR pipeline is published, but 'updated version' is unidentified.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the modified CPACOR implementation (fork or patch) with a commit hash, and state which release of the original it derives from.

gaps.where: Methods > all R-based steps (C7, C9, C10, C11, C13, C15, C16)
gaps.missing: 2a - no version is given for any R package. lme4, emmeans, ENmix, missMethyl, bacon and variancePartition are cited bibliographically only. Only the interpreter is pinned: 'All analyses were conducted using R version 4.4.1.' No Bioconductor release is named, no sessionInfo, no renv.lock, no conda environment, no container.
gaps.how_to_close: Report sessionInfo() output or ship an renv.lock / conda environment file pinning the interpreter, the Bioconductor release and every package version.

gaps.missing: The only external reference resource consumed is the Illumina manifest, pinned in prose as 'Illumina MethylationEPIC v1 B5'. The pin therefore lives only in the paper text; there is no workflow to check, so env_capture_class cannot be assigned (would be class B at best if code existed). Left as n/a per the stage-1 prose-only rule.
gaps.how_to_close: Fetch the manifest inside the analysis code from a fixed versioned URL or checksum, and record the checksum alongside the results.

gaps.missing: Genotype quality control and the derivation of the two genotype PCs are deferred entirely to 'Supplementary information S2'; the genotype data themselves (Mueller et al. 2024, n = 560) have no accession stated here either, and no QC code is available.
gaps.how_to_close: State the genotyping array, the QC software and thresholds in the main text, cite the genotype data accession, and deposit the QC script.

gaps.where: Methods > preprocessing (C1, C2), genotype QC (C6), bacon correction (C13)
gaps.missing: Three of the most consequential methodological blocks (QC thresholds, genotype QC, bacon correction details) are externalised into Supplementary Information S1-S3, which were not retrieved at Stage 1. The main-text description alone is not sufficient to re-derive the 642,148 / 606,546 / 562,713 site denominators.
gaps.how_to_close: Retrieve S1-S3 at Stage 2 (or on re-assessment) and re-score C1, C2, C6, C13; the authors should additionally summarise the operative thresholds in the main Methods.

gaps.where: Methods > Study cohort, Study procedures, Quantification of DNA methylation (W1-W4)
gaps.missing: Four wet-lab / clinical steps are non-computational and excluded from |S| by scope, not by defect: DNA extraction, bisulfite conversion, EPIC array hybridisation and scanning, and the HAMD-17/M.I.N.I./SCID-II clinical assessment.
gaps.how_to_close: Not applicable - out of scope for computational reproducibility (documentation-audit only). Kit names, vendors and input amounts are in fact stated.
